All Roads to Peace#000.dst: 与 [-{~}, -{~}] 的 Goruca 上尉交谈

All Roads to Peace#001.src: Hm. It's been long enough, we should've heard back from the diplomacy squad by now...
All Roads to Peace#001.dst: 嗯。已经过了够久了，外交小队早该有消息回来了……
All Roads to Peace#001.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#002.src: Ah, hello there, Wynn soldier. You should stick around! We were just launching a counterattack against the orc citadel.
All Roads to Peace#002.dst: 啊，你好，Wynn 士兵。你该留下来看看！我们刚对兽人堡垒发起反攻。
All Roads to Peace#002.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#003.src: Since you've helped with curbing the orcs elsewhere, you can join in the festivities- Oh, that's them coming over the hills!
All Roads to Peace#003.dst: 既然你在别处帮忙压制过兽人，你也可以来凑凑热闹——噢，他们翻过山丘回来了！
All Roads to Peace#003.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#005.src: I don't know, but they just decimated our golems with it. How are we supposed to deal with that chieftain without our protection?
All Roads to Peace#005.dst: 我不知道，但他们用那东西把我们的魔像全砸烂了。没有保护，我们要怎么对付那个酋长？
All Roads to Peace#005.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#006.src: Let's just get to the medical tent and go from there. The captain will need to hear about this.
All Roads to Peace#006.dst: 先去医疗帐篷再说吧。上尉得知道这件事。
All Roads to Peace#006.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#008.src: ...why do you always have to embarrass me in front of the humans, you idiots...
All Roads to Peace#008.dst: ……你们这群笨蛋，为什么老是要在人类面前让我丢脸……
All Roads to Peace#008.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#010.src: Follow the captain to the medical tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#010.dst: 跟着上尉前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的医疗帐篷

All Roads to Peace#011.src: You lot are useless, you are! We had you sent off with thirty golems! THIRTY! And you come back with nothing to show? Do you have any idea how much that cost us?!
All Roads to Peace#011.dst: 你们这帮废物，真是废物！我们派了三十只魔像跟你们去！三十只！结果你们两手空空回来？你们知不知道那花了我们多少钱？！
All Roads to Peace#011.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#014.src: ...fine. I suppose you have a point. And that means it's a good thing we have a human here to pick up all your slack.
All Roads to Peace#014.dst: ……好吧。我想你们说得也有道理。那也就是说，还好这里有个人类能替你们收拾烂摊子。
All Roads to Peace#014.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#016.src: There have been many attacks here at town, and we've been struggling to fend them off. Thanks to the incompetence of our troops, we haven't been able to-
All Roads to Peace#016.dst: 镇上已经遭到很多次攻击，我们一直疲于应付。都怪我们的部队无能，我们还没能——
All Roads to Peace#016.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#017.src: ORC CATAPULT!! ORC CATAPULT!! Listen to the words I am telling you! ORC! CATAPULT!
All Roads to Peace#017.dst: 兽人投石机！！兽人投石机！！听我说的话啊！兽人！投石机！
All Roads to Peace#017.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#018.src: ...we haven't been able to get the orc chieftain to listen to reason and sign a new ceasefire yet. If this keeps up, we'll be overwhelmed. The brutes only seem to listen to force...
All Roads to Peace#018.dst: ……我们还没能让兽人酋长讲道理，签下新的停火协议。再这样下去，我们会被淹没的。那帮野蛮人好像只听得懂武力……
All Roads to Peace#018.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#020.src: The fortress is off to the northeast, it's visible from town. Don't come back without a ceasefire- Or the chieftain's head, if peace is out of the question!
All Roads to Peace#020.dst: 堡垒在东北边，从镇上就看得到。没拿到停火协议就别回来——如果和平没得谈，那就带酋长的人头回来！
All Roads to Peace#020.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#022.src: Hmh! Human! Just like say, Serepe. Villager fail, then send human to kill.
All Roads to Peace#022.dst: 哼！人类！跟说的一样，Serepe。村民失败，就派人类来杀。
All Roads to Peace#022.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#023.src: Idiot big-noses! Human strong, but only one. Need more to break Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#023.dst: 笨蛋大鼻子！人类强，但只有一个。要更多才打破 Centerworld！
All Roads to Peace#023.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#026.src: Idiot. Idiot human. Will die in open. Come.
All Roads to Peace#026.dst: 笨蛋。笨蛋人类。在外面会死。来。

All Roads to Peace#027.src: RRRGHH! Armor heavy! How human carry much weight, but so weak without?!
All Roads to Peace#027.dst: 呃啊啊！盔甲重！人类怎么背这么重，脱了却这么弱？！

All Roads to Peace#028.src: Need medicine for...urgh. Blood... Where yarrow root...
All Roads to Peace#028.dst: 需要药……呃。血……蓍草根在哪……

All Roads to Peace#030.src: Name Zuett. Your name, Idiot. But only because taught wrong. So will help idiot. Take medicine.
All Roads to Peace#030.dst: 名字 Zuett。你名字，笨蛋。但只因为教错了。所以帮笨蛋。吃药。

All Roads to Peace#031.src: Hmh! Better than silly magic potion. Earth heals best...
All Roads to Peace#031.dst: 哼！比傻魔法药水好。大地治得最好……
All Roads to Peace#031.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#033.src: Hmh. Mhm, mhm. Yes, idiot villagers come by, lots of metal villager too. Say want peace- just want kill. Evil war machines.
All Roads to Peace#033.dst: 哼。嗯，嗯。对，笨蛋村民来过，很多铁村民也来。说要和平——只想杀。邪恶战争机器。
All Roads to Peace#033.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#034.src: Human really want peace? Then listen to Zuett. Killing not the way. Orcs strong, but not killers. Villager say, but villager wrong.
All Roads to Peace#034.dst: 人类真想要和平？那听 Zuett。杀不是办法。兽人强，但不是杀手。村民那样说，但村民错。
All Roads to Peace#034.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#035.src: We... Orcs... Not listen to just force. Orcs see strength, not idiot-killing. Human been idiot-killing. Time to stop.
All Roads to Peace#035.dst: 我们……兽人……不只听武力。兽人看力量，不是看笨蛋乱杀。人类一直在笨蛋乱杀。该停了。
All Roads to Peace#035.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#036.src: Whole war stupid. War killing us. Not all Orcs meant to fight. Human need learn first.
All Roads to Peace#036.dst: 整场战争蠢。战争在杀我们。不是所有兽人都该打仗。人类要先学。
All Roads to Peace#036.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#037.src: Need talk with Arrai-Veretel. But first, need trust. To start trust, listen to Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#037.dst: 要跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。但先要信任。要开始信任，听 Zuett。
All Roads to Peace#037.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#038.src: Will give guards peace offer. [Elite Boar Meat]. Go hunt. Look bushes up north.
All Roads to Peace#038.dst: 会给守卫和平礼物。[精英野猪肉]。去打猎。去北边灌木丛找。
All Roads to Peace#038.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#039.src: If want walk away like coward, do now. If human trust me...meet by fort after get meat.
All Roads to Peace#039.dst: 要是想像懦夫一样走掉，现在走。要是人类信我……拿到肉后在堡垒旁见。
All Roads to Peace#039.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#040.src: Travel to the hunting grounds at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#041.src: Speak to Zuett with the Elite Boar Meat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#041.dst: 带着精英野猪肉，与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Zuett 交谈

All Roads to Peace#042.src: Hmh. Hunt like child, but succeed anyway. Human should rely less on magic. Human serious, though.
All Roads to Peace#042.dst: 哼。打猎像小孩，但还是成功。人类该少靠魔法。不过人类是认真的。
All Roads to Peace#042.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#043.src: Good. Human really want peace. Help stop stupid war... Even though human and villager start anyway...
All Roads to Peace#043.dst: 好。人类真想要和平。帮忙停止蠢战争……就算人类和村民先开始……
All Roads to Peace#043.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#044.src: Follow. We go Centerworld. Guards still angry, but can say good for you. Stay quiet- Zuett do talk.
All Roads to Peace#044.dst: 跟上。我们去 Centerworld。守卫还在生气，但可以替你说好话。安静——Zuett 来说。
All Roads to Peace#044.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#045.src: Zuett! What you do? Thought drag away human to kill for good! Why bringing back now?
All Roads to Peace#045.dst: Zuett！你干什么？以为你把人类拖走彻底杀掉！为什么现在带回来？
All Roads to Peace#045.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#046.src: Zuett bleeding heart. Strong in compassion. Saw hurt, thought help. Stupid, but can respect.
All Roads to Peace#046.dst: Zuett 心软。同情心强。看到受伤，就想帮。蠢，但可以尊重。
All Roads to Peace#046.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#047.src: Listen to Zuett! Human want peace. Came for peace, but was taught peace come from idiot-killing by villager.
All Roads to Peace#047.dst: 听 Zuett 说！人类想要和平。为和平而来，但被村民教说和平靠笨蛋乱杀。
All Roads to Peace#047.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#048.src: Grrrh! All human say! What special about this human?
All Roads to Peace#048.dst: 呃啊！人类都这么说！这个人类有什么特别？
All Roads to Peace#048.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#049.src: Human listen to Zuett. Hunt spineback boar, bring meat. See? If human not care, human not listen. Not hunt.
All Roads to Peace#049.dst: 人类听 Zuett。去猎刺背野猪，带回肉。看？人类不在乎的话，人类不会听。不会去打猎。
All Roads to Peace#049.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#051.src: But strong not mean trust! Strength of body only one thing.
All Roads to Peace#051.dst: 但强不代表信任！身体的力量只是一种。
All Roads to Peace#051.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#052.src: RESSINTER HURT! RESSINTER HURT BAD! NEED HELP!! HELP NOW!!
All Roads to Peace#052.dst: RESSINTER 受伤！RESSINTER 伤很重！要帮忙！！现在帮忙！！

All Roads to Peace#053.src: Onluk! Tell what happen! Ressinter...healer hurt?
All Roads to Peace#053.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#055.src: KREIMU! Get Kreimu! Mudspring camp! She good healer!
All Roads to Peace#055.dst: KREIMU！找 Kreimu！Mudspring 营地！她是好医者！
All Roads to Peace#055.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#056.src: Will go! Fast runner! Ressinter no die today! Serepe, deal with human!
All Roads to Peace#056.dst: 我去！跑得快！Ressinter 今天不会死！Serepe，处理人类！
All Roads to Peace#056.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#058.src: Gwuh?! Zuett! Lying bad! Human idiot no hea-
All Roads to Peace#058.dst: 呃？！Zuett！说谎不好！人类笨蛋不会治——
All Roads to Peace#058.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#059.src: RESSINTER DYING! NO CARE IF LIE! ANY HEALER BETTER THAN NO HEALER!
All Roads to Peace#059.dst: RESSINTER 快死了！不管是不是说谎！有医者总比没医者好！
All Roads to Peace#059.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#060.src: HEY! ONLUK IDIOT! NO LET HUMAN IN!
All Roads to Peace#060.dst: 喂！ONLUK 笨蛋！不准让人类进去！
All Roads to Peace#060.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#062.src: Follow Onluk to the Medicine Tent through the fortress
All Roads to Peace#062.dst: 穿过堡垒，跟着 Onluk 前往医药帐篷

All Roads to Peace#063.src: Cannon backfire! Caught in blast! Cut up all over, bleeding bad! Healer already brought medicine tent!
All Roads to Peace#063.dst: 大炮走火！被炸到！全身都是伤口，流血很多！医者已经抬到医药帐篷！
All Roads to Peace#063.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#064.src: Hhhgh. Bad injury... Human. Heal Ressinter, fast!
All Roads to Peace#064.dst: 呃呃。伤很重……人类。治 Ressinter，快！
All Roads to Peace#064.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#065.src: Make balm to keep healer alive! Even if only keep alive for Kreimu to heal, keep Ressinter alive!
All Roads to Peace#065.dst: 做药膏让医者活着！就算只撑到 Kreimu 来治，也要让 Ressinter 活着！
All Roads to Peace#065.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#066.src: Mix herbs. Use medicine book. And stay in tent!
All Roads to Peace#066.dst: 混草药。用药书。待在帐篷里！
All Roads to Peace#066.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#067.src: Save the injured orc, or keep it alive until rescue arrives
All Roads to Peace#067.dst: 救活受伤的兽人，或让它撑到救援抵达

All Roads to Peace#069.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#069.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#070.src: Here in time. Ressinter still alive...why other balm on cuts?
All Roads to Peace#070.dst: 来得及。Ressinter 还活着……为什么伤口上有别的药膏？
All Roads to Peace#070.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#071.src: Wait, why human here? Ressinter hurt because human?
All Roads to Peace#071.dst: 等等，人类为什么在这？Ressinter 受伤是因为人类？
All Roads to Peace#071.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#072.dst: 不是，人类在试着治 Ressinter！
All Roads to Peace#072.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#073.src: Human try heal Ressinter. Thought better healer than Zuett. Try hard to keep Ressinter alive.
All Roads to Peace#073.dst: 人类试着治 Ressinter。以为比 Zuett 更会治。很努力让 Ressinter 活着。
All Roads to Peace#073.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#074.src: ... ... ...Nunexetor. You sensible. Is true? Human try heal Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#074.dst: ………………Nunexetor。你明理。是真的？人类试着治 Ressinter？
All Roads to Peace#074.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#075.src: Yes. The human made herb balms and tried to heal Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#075.dst: 是的。人类做了草药膏，试着治疗 Ressinter。
All Roads to Peace#075.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#076.src: So Zuett not lie. Human care about orc?
All Roads to Peace#076.dst: 所以 Zuett 没说谎。人类在乎兽人？
All Roads to Peace#076.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#077.src: See? Human try. Maybe not heal Ressinter full, but try save life of someone call enemy by idiot Villager.
All Roads to Peace#077.dst: 看？人类有试。也许没完全治好 Ressinter，但试着救被笨蛋村民叫作敌人的性命。
All Roads to Peace#077.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#078.src: Human learn Villagers lie. Trying learn about us. War only because Villagers trick! Not because human bad!
All Roads to Peace#078.dst: 人类知道村民说谎。在试着了解我们。战争只因为村民骗人！不是因为人类坏！
All Roads to Peace#078.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#079.src: ...hmh! Can respect. Strong in mind if able to learn.
All Roads to Peace#079.dst: ……哼！可以尊重。能学习，就是心智强。
All Roads to Peace#079.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#082.src: Will stay for while in case Ressinter need medicine more.
All Roads to Peace#082.dst: 会待一阵子，以防 Ressinter 还需要药。
All Roads to Peace#082.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#083.src: Sorry to put human up to task sudden, but now more orc trust you.
All Roads to Peace#083.dst: 抱歉突然让人类做事，但现在更多兽人信任你。
All Roads to Peace#083.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#084.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#084.dst: 既然兽人信任……也许现在可以跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。跟上。
All Roads to Peace#084.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#086.src: No! Lomoster okay! Ressinter not okay- Wait. Ressinter sort of okay! Need rest still!
All Roads to Peace#086.dst: 不！Lomoster 没事！Ressinter 有事——等等。Ressinter 算没事！还要休息！
All Roads to Peace#086.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#087.src: But Lomoster at cannon when explode!
All Roads to Peace#087.dst: 但大炮爆炸时 Lomoster 在旁边！
All Roads to Peace#087.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#088.src: Lomoster wear armor. Armor took hurt, Lomoster okay!
All Roads to Peace#088.dst: Lomoster 穿盔甲。盔甲挡了伤，Lomoster 没事！
All Roads to Peace#088.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#089.dst: ……嗯……好吧……等等，人类为什么在这？
All Roads to Peace#089.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#090.src: Human heal Ressinter. See? Human good healer!
All Roads to Peace#090.dst: 人类治好 Ressinter。看？人类是好医者！
All Roads to Peace#090.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#091.src: I don't believe it. How did-
All Roads to Peace#091.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#093.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting, I- Whuh...
All Roads to Peace#093.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#094.dst: Ressinter 已经没事！Bitteliso 说谎？！
All Roads to Peace#094.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#095.src: Wait, Ressinter okay? How did- HUMAN?! WHY HUMAN IN CAMP?!
All Roads to Peace#095.dst: 等等，Ressinter 没事？怎么会——人类？！人类为什么在营地？！
All Roads to Peace#095.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#096.src: Human heal Ressinter! Not know how, but human save Ressinter life!
All Roads to Peace#096.dst: 人类治好 Ressinter！不知道怎么做到，但人类救了 Ressinter 的命！
All Roads to Peace#096.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#097.src: Told Bitteliso. Human learning! Save life of orc, even though idiot Villager say kill.
All Roads to Peace#097.dst: 跟 Bitteliso 说过。人类在学！救兽人的命，就算笨蛋村民说要杀。
All Roads to Peace#097.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#098.src: ...how. How. HOW! How human so good at healing?! Why human help?
All Roads to Peace#098.dst: ……怎么。怎么。怎么！人类怎么这么会治？！人类为什么帮忙？
All Roads to Peace#098.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#099.src: Can trust human. Human try unlearn bad villager teach.
All Roads to Peace#099.dst: 可以信任人类。人类在试着忘掉坏村民教的。
All Roads to Peace#099.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#100.src: ...fine. Good human, not stupid human. Bitteliso sorry for beating. Here.
All Roads to Peace#100.dst: ……好吧。好人类，不是蠢人类。Bitteliso 为打你道歉。给。
All Roads to Peace#100.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#101.src: Shouldn't we get back to what we were doing?
All Roads to Peace#101.dst: 我们不是该回去做刚才的事了吗？
All Roads to Peace#101.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#102.src: ...will stay in case Ressinter need help.
All Roads to Peace#102.dst: ……会待着，以防 Ressinter 需要帮忙。
All Roads to Peace#102.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#103.src: Ressinter not old man! No need sitter!
All Roads to Peace#103.dst: Ressinter 不是老头！不需要看护！
All Roads to Peace#103.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#104.src: Not know that human actually good at heal! Very good! Healer, not hunter. More orc trust you now.
All Roads to Peace#104.dst: 不知道人类真的会治！非常会！是医者，不是猎人。现在更多兽人信任你。
All Roads to Peace#104.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#105.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow!
All Roads to Peace#105.dst: 既然兽人信任……也许现在可以跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。跟上！
All Roads to Peace#105.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#106.src: Follow Zuett through the Orcish Fortress
All Roads to Peace#106.dst: 跟着 Zuett 穿过兽人堡垒

All Roads to Peace#107.src: No enter! Much camp see human heal, but still no trust human!
All Roads to Peace#107.dst: 不准进！很多营地看到人类治疗，但还是不信任人类！
All Roads to Peace#107.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#108.src: Ureietun! Human help save Ressinter life! Why no trust?
All Roads to Peace#108.dst: Ureietun！人类帮忙救了 Ressinter 的命！为什么不信任？
All Roads to Peace#108.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#109.src: Human being led by you. Human led by villager too! Teach good thing, yes, but what if human just copying?
All Roads to Peace#109.dst: 人类被你带着走。人类也被村民带着走！教好事，是，但要是人类只是在模仿呢？
All Roads to Peace#109.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#110.src: Human can earn trust alone! Zuett, stay in Arrai-room.
All Roads to Peace#110.dst: 人类可以自己赢得信任！Zuett，待在 Arrai 房间。
All Roads to Peace#110.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#112.src: RRRRRGH! STUPID ZUETT! WAR HAPPEN FOR REASON! GO AWAY!
All Roads to Peace#112.dst: 呃啊啊啊啊！蠢 ZUETT！战争发生有原因！走开！
All Roads to Peace#112.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#113.src: ...can trust human not kill. Human can walk around Centerworld. But human no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#113.dst: ……可以信任人类不会杀。人类可以在 Centerworld 走动。但人类不能见 Arrai-Veretel！
All Roads to Peace#113.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#114.src: Ask various orcs if they need any help at the Orcish Fortress at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
All Roads to Peace#114.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的兽人堡垒询问各个兽人是否需要帮忙。

All Roads to Peace#115.src: Hm! Human, hunter, healer, halfwit soldier. Many things! Human also runner?
All Roads to Peace#115.dst: 嗯！人类，猎人，医者，半吊子士兵。好多身份！人类也是跑者？
All Roads to Peace#115.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#116.src: Peloros from Holehold. Camp home to messengers and runners. Have thing to deliver to Fruludir in green tower.
All Roads to Peace#116.dst: Peloros 来自 Holehold。那营地是信使和跑者的家。有东西要送给绿塔里的 Fruludir。
All Roads to Peace#116.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#118.src: Then human run fast to green tower- deliver in {~} seconds! Or else come back. Not urgent delivery, so delay fine.
All Roads to Peace#118.dst: 那人类快跑去绿塔——{~} 秒内送到！不然就回来。不是急件，晚点也没关系。
All Roads to Peace#118.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#119.src: Will know human delivered in time. How? Human will see if run fast!
All Roads to Peace#119.dst: 会知道人类有没有准时送到。怎么知道？人类跑得快就会看到！
All Roads to Peace#119.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#120.src: RGH! Can understand just fine, just not speak as good! No mock us!
All Roads to Peace#120.dst: 呃啊！听得懂，只是说不好！不准嘲笑我们！
All Roads to Peace#120.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#121.src: Hm! Human have Peloros box. Peloros give human run training. Give here.
All Roads to Peace#121.dst: 嗯！人类拿着 Peloros 的箱子。Peloros 给人类跑步训练。给我。
All Roads to Peace#121.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#122.src: More than Zuett with human? Good sign. Maybe fighting stop soon.
All Roads to Peace#122.dst: 跟人类一起的不只 Zuett？好兆头。也许很快就不打仗了。
All Roads to Peace#122.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#123.src: Patience, human. Box full of signal flare. Will light one to show Peloros human got here in time.
All Roads to Peace#123.dst: 耐心点，人类。箱子里装满信号烟火。会点一个，让 Peloros 知道人类准时到。
All Roads to Peace#123.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#124.src: Saw the firework. Human did well, finishing single morning exercise!
All Roads to Peace#124.dst: 看到烟火了。人类做得好，完成一次晨练！
All Roads to Peace#124.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#125.src: Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#125.dst: 兽人要做很多训练才能保持强壮。兽人跑者一定要快、不会累，才能成为马拉松！
All Roads to Peace#125.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#126.src: Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
All Roads to Peace#126.dst: 给。人类拿去。更努力训练。也许去 Holehold 看看——也是放松的地方，不只是跑步。耐力对大家都好。
All Roads to Peace#126.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#127.src: Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
All Roads to Peace#127.dst: 噢。帮了 Ressinter 的人类。你很奇怪。一点都不像别的人类。
All Roads to Peace#127.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#128.src: This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
All Roads to Peace#128.dst: 这个？这是食物仓库。主要放肉和根茎。不过，很快会有大型仪式。
All Roads to Peace#128.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#129.src: Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
All Roads to Peace#129.dst: Earthpit 的节庆。快到了——所以在为那个储备食物。
All Roads to Peace#129.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#130.src: ...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
All Roads to Peace#130.dst: ……人类看起来想帮忙。你……真的很奇怪。我想……如果你想帮忙准备食物，可以去钓点鱼。
All Roads to Peace#130.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#131.src: Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
All Roads to Peace#131.dst: 不会要人类全包——只要够帮忙的 [{~} 鲤鱼肉]。不过，想多带也可以。
All Roads to Peace#131.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#132.src: If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
All Roads to Peace#132.dst: 如果想带超过 {~} 条，超过 {~} 条也会收下。
All Roads to Peace#132.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#133.src: Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
All Roads to Peace#133.dst: 嗯，嗯。你是奇怪的人类，但不是坏人类。这些肉够了。
All Roads to Peace#133.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#134.src: Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
All Roads to Peace#134.dst: 节庆还要很久，不过，给你。人类帮了忙，就该有报酬。这才公平。
All Roads to Peace#134.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#135.src: Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
All Roads to Peace#135.dst: 噢，你带的鱼比要的多。是要的两倍！
All Roads to Peace#135.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#136.src: You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
All Roads to Peace#136.dst: 你是好人类。奇怪，但不坏。愿意多出一份力。
All Roads to Peace#136.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#137.src: Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
All Roads to Peace#137.dst: 给——也分你一些不是节庆用的肉。还有别的报酬。
All Roads to Peace#137.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#138.src: ...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
All Roads to Peace#138.dst: ……这……好多鱼。你有听到我说五条吧？
All Roads to Peace#138.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#139.src: Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
All Roads to Peace#139.dst: 公平份量的四倍。人类为什么会这样？
All Roads to Peace#139.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#140.src: Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
All Roads to Peace#140.dst: 人类应该很自私。听村民的话去杀兽人。但你完全不是那样。
All Roads to Peace#140.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#141.src: Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
All Roads to Peace#141.dst: 那给——分你额外的肉。不是节庆用的，但还是好肉。还有别的东西。非常谢谢你，人类。
All Roads to Peace#141.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#143.src: Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
All Roads to Peace#143.dst: 说五条。你有三十条。我……怎么会，为什么。
All Roads to Peace#143.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#144.src: You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
All Roads to Peace#144.dst: 你刚做了六个兽人的工作。你是……超额完成的人类。但那不是坏事！
All Roads to Peace#144.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#145.src: Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
All Roads to Peace#145.dst: 那给。这肉不是节庆用的，但你付出这么多，值得吃顿丰盛的饭！
All Roads to Peace#145.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#146.src: That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
All Roads to Peace#146.dst: 这么多鱼真的达到配额了！太谢谢你了，奇怪又善良的人类！
All Roads to Peace#146.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#149.src: Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#149.dst: 人类主动要帮忙——哼！非常好的人类！任务简单。堡垒东南边，过了山脊，是 Teiren 的旧营地。
All Roads to Peace#149.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#150.src: Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
All Roads to Peace#150.dst: 以前住那里，但因为 Freelancer 从山上跳下来就走了。忘了重要的东西在那！
All Roads to Peace#150.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#151.src: Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#151.dst: 要留在这里，确保蠢 Peloros 不会跑进火坑。以前跑进去过。所以，你去拿！
All Roads to Peace#151.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#152.src: Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
All Roads to Peace#152.dst: 喂，喂！你最好马上把那个还给我，小姑娘！
All Roads to Peace#152.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#153.src: Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
All Roads to Peace#153.dst: 绝对不要，你这懦弱的风灵！这现在是我的了！
All Roads to Peace#153.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#155.src: Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
All Roads to Peace#155.dst: 胡说八道！这营地是由尊重大地与其恩赐的人建的。现在住民都走了，大自然就可以把它收回来，这才是正理！
All Roads to Peace#155.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#156.src: Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
All Roads to Peace#156.dst: 噢是吗？就这样？你是个可人儿，姑娘，但你要是不马上交出来，我就剪了你的花瓣！
All Roads to Peace#156.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#157.src: What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
All Roads to Peace#157.dst: 你这粗鲁的无赖，竟敢威胁大自然的化身！我不会不战而降的！
All Roads to Peace#157.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#159.src: ...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
All Roads to Peace#159.dst: ……嗯？你又是谁？什么风把一个人类吹到这个荒废的地方？
All Roads to Peace#159.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#160.src: Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
All Roads to Peace#160.dst: 噢不，你也想要这个？！我已经宣告它是我的了！别来烦我，走！离开这里！
All Roads to Peace#160.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#161.src: Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
All Roads to Peace#161.dst: 你不该惹我的，宝贝！下次记住是谁帮你传花粉的，嗯？！现在只要把这东西带回山上……
All Roads to Peace#161.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#162.src: OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
All Roads to Peace#162.dst: 喂！这又是哪来的小丑？你是想把钱包倒空给我还是怎样？
All Roads to Peace#162.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#163.src: What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
All Roads to Peace#163.dst: 什么，你也想要这东西？！这是我的，听到没？我的！你拿不走！
All Roads to Peace#163.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#164.src: Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
All Roads to Peace#164.dst: 人类！派你去是对的。Peloros 从椅子上摔下来，差点烧起来！找到东西了吗？很有特色，营地只剩那一样东西。
All Roads to Peace#164.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#165.src: Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
All Roads to Peace#165.dst: 嗯嗯！！对！就是在找这个！非常好的人类！人类是好人类，应该有报酬！
All Roads to Peace#165.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#166.src: Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
All Roads to Peace#166.dst: 噢？人类不知道这东西是什么？想知道？
All Roads to Peace#166.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#167.src: Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
All Roads to Peace#167.dst: 傻瓜！人类不知道是什么，就不告诉！可以自己去了解。
All Roads to Peace#167.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#170.src: Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
All Roads to Peace#170.dst: 呃啊！人类！你们语言笨！名字很聪明，在兽人语里像水一样流畅，写成人类语言就像纸上一堆粪！
All Roads to Peace#170.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#171.src: Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
All Roads to Peace#171.dst: 念名字！看拼法，念名字！试试看！！试试看！！！
All Roads to Peace#171.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#173.src: GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
All Roads to Peace#173.dst: 呃啊啊！名字搞混了！在兽人语里不会混！人类全念错！
All Roads to Peace#173.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#174.src: Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
All Roads to Peace#174.dst: 哼。对了，人类。至少愿意试。看到名字写出来多糟了吗？
All Roads to Peace#174.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#175.src: Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
All Roads to Peace#175.dst: 念作“顺-布”。用人类字母写出来根本不像！
All Roads to Peace#175.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#176.src: Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
All Roads to Peace#176.dst: 给。刚才是在气蠢语言，不是气人类。
All Roads to Peace#176.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#177.src: Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
All Roads to Peace#177.dst: 蠢蠢蠢！跟拼法一点都不像！现在看到语言多蠢了吧？！
All Roads to Peace#177.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#178.src: GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
All Roads to Peace#178.dst: 啊啊啊！！不，不，不，不！！！为什么要学人类语言？！
All Roads to Peace#178.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#179.src: NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#179.dst: 名字不是 JOE！JOE 是什么名字？！JOE 蠢名字！！！啊啊啊！！
All Roads to Peace#179.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#183.dst: 呼……哈……人……人类！奇怪……奇怪的人类！
All Roads to Peace#183.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#184.src: Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
All Roads to Peace#184.dst: 石头卡住。在试着举起来——为了练力气！没人举得起来。
All Roads to Peace#184.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#185.src: Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
All Roads to Peace#185.dst: Yunelsu 想把石头丢进河里！丢过别的石头，这块没有。
All Roads to Peace#185.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#187.src: Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
All Roads to Peace#187.dst: 嗯……人类魔法强，但石头还是不动。
All Roads to Peace#187.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#188.src: Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
All Roads to Peace#188.dst: 一起来！对石头施魔法，我再试着举！准备！
All Roads to Peace#188.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#190.src: Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
All Roads to Peace#190.dst: 呃……呼。一定是……古老的大地之石。
All Roads to Peace#190.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#191.src: Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
All Roads to Peace#191.dst: 在这里很久很久了。卡在这里，石头待在大地要它待的地方。
All Roads to Peace#191.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#192.src: Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
All Roads to Peace#192.dst: 那 Yunelsu 找别的石头。不过有时候石头会碎。
All Roads to Peace#192.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#193.src: See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
All Roads to Peace#193.dst: 看？好多碎石头。听说拿来做盔甲不错。你拿去。
All Roads to Peace#193.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#194.src: Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
All Roads to Peace#194.dst: 噢！你！看到 Zuett 把你拖来营地。也看到别的事。
All Roads to Peace#194.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#195.src: And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#195.dst: 而且你帮了 Ressinter！之后会道歉。是我的错。人类见过 Freelancer 吗？
All Roads to Peace#195.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#196.src: Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
All Roads to Peace#196.dst: Freelancer 以为什么都是他们的。常在堡垒附近晃，有时候想跳进来。
All Roads to Peace#196.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#197.src: Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
All Roads to Peace#197.dst: 本来想把飞着的那个打下来，但大炮坏了，炮弹爆炸。
All Roads to Peace#197.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#198.src: Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
All Roads to Peace#198.dst: 现在 Ressinter 没事了，但大炮还要修。人类想帮忙的话，修理需要 [{~} 铁锭]。
All Roads to Peace#198.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#199.src: Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
All Roads to Peace#199.dst: 路很远，但村民采石场东边的山谷有铁。那里也有别的村民，带着武器。不知道为什么。
All Roads to Peace#199.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#200.src: Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
All Roads to Peace#200.dst: 人类热心得奇怪。不过那样好！让 Lomoster 打敌人的工作轻松点。
All Roads to Peace#200.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#201.src: Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
All Roads to Peace#201.dst: 给。Freelancer 喜欢偷金属跟别的东西，打下来找到很多。人类可以拿去。
All Roads to Peace#201.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#202.src: Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
All Roads to Peace#202.dst: 不适合修大炮，但大概适合做别的东西。
All Roads to Peace#202.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#204.src: Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
All Roads to Peace#204.dst: 她的名字，我的名字，听起来一样。在兽人语里不一样！但在你们的语言里，听起来一样！
All Roads to Peace#204.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#208.src: Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
All Roads to Peace#208.dst: 嘟囔……笨 Kreimu……人类有茎秆吗？
All Roads to Peace#208.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#209.src: Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
All Roads to Peace#209.dst: 好。那可以拿这个——Alraune 女孩有时候有。好吃，但不是好药。
All Roads to Peace#209.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#210.src: Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
All Roads to Peace#210.dst: 其实 Durbeo 可能会喜欢。Durbeo 是我后面食物仓库塔里的兽人。也许他也想要帮忙？
All Roads to Peace#210.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#211.src: Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
All Roads to Peace#211.dst: 噢，是那个治好 Ressinter 的人类。对，我已经听说你了。这里消息传得很快。
All Roads to Peace#211.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#212.src: You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
All Roads to Peace#212.dst: 你的脸好奇怪。呃，我是说你脸上的表情很奇怪。怎么，不习惯说话比较流利的兽人？
All Roads to Peace#212.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#213.src: I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
All Roads to Peace#213.dst: 因为我在学语言。我还没全部学会，所以如果你愿意帮忙，我会很需要。
All Roads to Peace#213.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#214.src: I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they've left behind any language books.
All Roads to Peace#214.dst: 我以前有个很聪明的霍比特朋友住在附近。他们已经走了，但我想请你去他们的霍比特洞看看，有没有留下什么语言书。
All Roads to Peace#214.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#215.src: It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
All Roads to Peace#215.dst: 应该就在山丘上的蓝塔附近。这应该很简单，对吧？
All Roads to Peace#215.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#216.src: Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
All Roads to Peace#216.dst: 噢，太好了，他们确实留下了一本书。这下我的收藏就齐了。这套书我有第一、第二、第四、第五和第六册。
All Roads to Peace#216.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#217.src: Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
All Roads to Peace#217.dst: 希望能从里面学到新东西。我还是搞不懂那些奇怪的“修辞”到底是什么意思……
All Roads to Peace#217.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#218.src: What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
All Roads to Peace#218.dst: “拼了老命”是什么意思？还有“一眨眼的工夫”？嗯，算了。你大概知道，所以我自己瞎猜很无聊。
All Roads to Peace#218.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#219.src: Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
All Roads to Peace#219.dst: 那么，给你。我那个朋友把遇到的一切都写进了几本日记，他把日记给我保管，但我没法读。
All Roads to Peace#219.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#220.src: The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
All Roads to Peace#220.dst: 纸太薄了——我一翻就会撕破。还好你给我的书是用结实的皮革装订的，不过我还是得小心别弄坏……
All Roads to Peace#220.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#221.src: Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things for yourself.
All Roads to Peace#221.dst: 嗯，也许你读读里面写的东西，能自己学到些什么。
All Roads to Peace#221.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#222.src: Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
All Roads to Peace#222.dst: 嗯。又是你。那个帮了 Ressinter 的怪人类。有什么事吗？
All Roads to Peace#222.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#223.src: Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
All Roads to Peace#223.dst: 嗯。还想帮忙？你怎么这么热心？说真的我不太习惯。不过，我想到一件事。
All Roads to Peace#223.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#224.src: HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
All Roads to Peace#224.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#225.src: Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!
All Roads to Peace#225.dst: 呃，想！我们在这里无聊死了！

All Roads to Peace#228.src: Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
All Roads to Peace#228.dst: 嗯，好啊，但是……就算你说这个没那么可怕，我也不想告诉他们我的真名！

All Roads to Peace#229.src: Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
All Roads to Peace#229.dst: 我们不是刚吃了一堆水果吗？可以拿来当假名啊！

All Roads to Peace#230.src: Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
All Roads to Peace#230.dst: 好吧。那叫我芒果吧，怪人类！
All Roads to Peace#230.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#231.src: I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
All Roads to Peace#231.dst: 我刚吃了一堆蓝莓，所以我暂时就叫蓝莓吧？
All Roads to Peace#231.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#232.src: Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
All Roads to Peace#232.dst: 嘿，其实谁叫我葡萄我都不介意！
All Roads to Peace#232.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#233.src: Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
All Roads to Peace#233.dst: 那我就是桃子！所以我们就是玩个捉迷藏？
All Roads to Peace#233.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#234.src: Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
All Roads to Peace#234.dst: 对。就在堡垒里找个地方躲起来。如果人类找不到你们，你们就赢了。
All Roads to Peace#234.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#235.src: Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
All Roads to Peace#235.dst: 嗯，那有点无聊，所以我要去找个超难到的地方！
All Roads to Peace#235.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#237.src: Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
All Roads to Peace#237.dst: 好了，就这样。来找我说话，我会告诉你还剩几个没找到。
All Roads to Peace#237.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#238.src: ...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
All Roads to Peace#238.dst: ……哇。你好厉害。我以为你可能看得到我在这上面，但没想到你上得来！
All Roads to Peace#238.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#239.src: I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
All Roads to Peace#239.dst: 我不在乎你是不是人类。只要有乐子我就开心。可惜这里没什么好玩的东西可以捣鼓。
All Roads to Peace#239.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#240.src: Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
All Roads to Peace#240.dst: Tinkernook 那边有机器、有金属、有东西可以实验和打造，比这里好太多了。
All Roads to Peace#240.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#241.src: Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
All Roads to Peace#241.dst: 总之，你赢了，我输了，我得回去找老古板 Nunexetor 了。拜拜！
All Roads to Peace#241.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#242.src: NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
All Roads to Peace#242.dst: 喵呀！你个子这么大，居然这么会偷偷摸到别人身后！！
All Roads to Peace#242.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#243.src: Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
All Roads to Peace#243.dst: 呃，我刚才还以为我完蛋了……既然 Nunny 说你没问题，那我就相信他，但你还是一样吓人！
All Roads to Peace#243.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#244.src: And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
All Roads to Peace#244.dst: 而且，我想在这种开阔的地方，其他兽人也不会让你欺负我们，所以……
All Roads to Peace#244.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#245.src: Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
All Roads to Peace#245.dst: 我想你大概还行吧。不过就算这样，你找到我了，所以我输了。除非你找不到其他人！
All Roads to Peace#245.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#246.src: I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
All Roads to Peace#246.dst: 我打赌你永远找不到芒果，哈哈哈！她玩这种游戏超级认真的！
All Roads to Peace#246.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#247.src: Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
All Roads to Peace#247.dst: 啊，可恶。我想在这上面挺容易被看到的。
All Roads to Peace#247.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#248.src: I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
All Roads to Peace#248.dst: 我是说，我知道啦，但我以为你不会想到要爬上塔！
All Roads to Peace#248.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#249.src: Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
All Roads to Peace#249.dst: 嗯，总之……你真的跑去试着治疗 Ressinter？那真是令人佩服！
All Roads to Peace#249.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#251.src: Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
All Roads to Peace#251.dst: 然——后就有个人类跑来把她杀了，大概是有人叫他们那么做吧！至少你看起来还算正派。
All Roads to Peace#251.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#252.src: Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
All Roads to Peace#252.dst: 总之，我回那个安静的老顽固那里去啦！
All Roads to Peace#252.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#253.src: Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
All Roads to Peace#253.dst: 啊！以为你不会注意到我躲在楼梯后面！
All Roads to Peace#253.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#254.src: Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
All Roads to Peace#254.dst: 呃，你……你们人类近看好可怕。Nunexetor 真的确定你不是坏人吗？
All Roads to Peace#254.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#255.src: I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
All Roads to Peace#255.dst: 我是说，看看你的盔甲！你，你看起来一眨眼就能把我拍扁在墙上！
All Roads to Peace#255.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#256.src: ...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
All Roads to Peace#256.dst: ……我觉得我好像刚给了你一个点子，我可不要留下来看结果！你赢了！
All Roads to Peace#256.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#257.src: Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
All Roads to Peace#257.dst: 看来人类赢了。我想我知道你是怎么找到那头刺背野猪的了。
All Roads to Peace#257.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#258.src: There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
All Roads to Peace#258.dst: 你不可能真的猎到那种东西。连兽人猎人都很难对付它们！
All Roads to Peace#258.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#259.src: Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
All Roads to Peace#259.dst: 你在开玩笑吗？人类超可怕的，蓝莓！他们猎过比蠢猪强多了的东西！
All Roads to Peace#259.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#260.src: But, the game was fun, right?
All Roads to Peace#260.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#262.src: That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
All Roads to Peace#262.dst: 我对你们要的就这些。现在可以回去做你们刚才在做的事了。
All Roads to Peace#262.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#263.src: Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
All Roads to Peace#263.dst: 耶，终于！我不用再担心那个人类会不会想戳我眼睛了！
All Roads to Peace#263.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#264.src: Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
All Roads to Peace#264.dst: 噢，别再当胆小鬼了。这个人很好！
All Roads to Peace#264.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#265.src: Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
All Roads to Peace#265.dst: 好游戏，我想！又回去无聊了。
All Roads to Peace#265.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#269.src: What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
All Roads to Peace#269.dst: 什么？你穿的根本不是那种鞋。
All Roads to Peace#269.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#270.src: Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
All Roads to Peace#270.dst: 总之，战利品归胜者。给，谢谢你陪他们玩了一会儿。
All Roads to Peace#270.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#271.src: They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#271.dst: 他们让我看着这些哥布林，但我不擅长陪他们玩，所以我想还是谢谢你。
All Roads to Peace#271.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#272.src: Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
All Roads to Peace#272.dst: 啊，怪人类。你为什么想帮忙？
All Roads to Peace#272.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#275.src: The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
All Roads to Peace#275.dst: 村民桥外面的洞穴，旁边有池塘和石拱。进去，会有蓝色的花。
All Roads to Peace#275.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#276.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
All Roads to Peace#276.dst: 拿 [{~} 土海蓝花苞] 来，才能做更多染料。不知道你为什么帮忙，但也不会拒绝帮忙。
All Roads to Peace#276.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#277.src: The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
All Roads to Peace#277.dst: 又是怪人类？你全身都是蓝色粉末。那你找到花了！
All Roads to Peace#277.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#278.src: Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
All Roads to Peace#278.dst: 给。帮你拿那个。花苞够用了，粉末你可以留着。
All Roads to Peace#278.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#279.src: Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
All Roads to Peace#279.dst: 再多给一点。不过，还是那句——你为什么想帮忙？不明白。人类杀了很多兽人。
All Roads to Peace#279.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#281.src: You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
All Roads to Peace#281.dst: 你是那个帮忙而不是杀戮的怪人类，对吧？Nunexetor 和小哥布林们在谈你。
All Roads to Peace#281.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#282.src: Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
All Roads to Peace#282.dst: 在试着把武器和工具弄得更好。在训练，但磨刀石快用完了。Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……那样念对吗？
All Roads to Peace#282.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#283.src: Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
All Roads to Peace#283.dst: 怪人类语言。总之，知道哪里有好磨刀石——堡垒东边的山顶。
All Roads to Peace#283.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#284.src: There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
All Roads to Peace#284.dst: Ledant 洞穴旁边有条近路通到山顶。也许有危险，但不会太危险。沿着路上的枯灌木走，就能很快到山顶。
All Roads to Peace#284.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#285.src: May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
All Roads to Peace#285.dst: 要是给我带来磨金属用的 [铅石]，可能会有好东西给你。
All Roads to Peace#285.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#286.src: Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
All Roads to Peace#286.dst: 你看——人类想帮忙？那帮 Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……拿——
All Roads to Peace#286.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#287.src: Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
All Roads to Peace#287.dst: 噢！你有 [铅石]！刚才在专心工作，没注意到。
All Roads to Peace#287.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#288.src: Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
All Roads to Peace#288.dst: 给。人类喜欢绿色宝石当钱，对吧？不过不适合打铁。
All Roads to Peace#288.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#290.src: Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
All Roads to Peace#290.dst: 嗯，医者人类。敢发誓，前阵子看到你在平原上走。来这里做什么？Ressinter 又受伤了？
All Roads to Peace#290.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#291.src: No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
All Roads to Peace#291.dst: 没有？嗯，现在好奇了。你试着治 Ressinter……是运气吗？还是人类真的知道草药有什么用？
All Roads to Peace#291.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#292.src: Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
All Roads to Peace#292.dst: 想考考。想看人类的医药知识。会问问题，人类回答。简单。准备好了？
All Roads to Peace#292.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#293.src: Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
All Roads to Peace#293.dst: 好！那么，第一题。银杏叶。银杏叶有什么用？
All Roads to Peace#293.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#294.src: Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
All Roads to Peace#294.dst: 对！好。银杏叶对脑子好。压力大时让人舒服，但会让血变稀。有时候有用，但可能危险。
All Roads to Peace#294.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#295.src: So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
All Roads to Peace#295.dst: 那么，第二题。香杨梅。香杨梅有什么用？
All Roads to Peace#295.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#296.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#296.dst: 不对。香杨梅不是用来帮这个的。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
All Roads to Peace#296.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#299.src: Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
All Roads to Peace#299.dst: 第三题。接骨木果。接骨木果有两种用处。接骨木果有什么用？
All Roads to Peace#299.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#300.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#300.dst: 不对，接骨木果对那些没用。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
All Roads to Peace#300.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#301.src: Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
All Roads to Peace#301.dst: 对！不过，接骨木果还有第三种用处。可以做好喝的饮料！接骨木果发酵会喝醉，但那不是药。
All Roads to Peace#301.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#302.src: Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
All Roads to Peace#302.dst: 给人类的最后一题。小白菊。小白菊对什么没帮助？
All Roads to Peace#302.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#303.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#303.dst: 小白菊治那个非常有效。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
All Roads to Peace#303.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#306.dst: 噗……哇哈哈哈哈！！！人、人类，好耶！我——哈哈！
All Roads to Peace#306.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#307.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#307.dst: 那个……答对了！不是正解，但答对了！你……哈哈，你帮 Ressinter 只是靠运气，对吧？人类根本不是医者。
All Roads to Peace#307.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#308.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#308.dst: 不过人类有幽默感！而且人类很努力帮忙。比大部分人类强多了。那给——多试着治疗，别当士兵了。
All Roads to Peace#308.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#309.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#309.dst: 世界需要更多愿意帮助别人的人。人类愿意尝试，代表很多好事。
All Roads to Peace#309.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#311.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#311.dst: 不对。银杏叶对那个不好。嗯，也许人类治 Ressinter 是靠运气……想的话可以再试。
All Roads to Peace#311.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#313.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#313.dst: 好吧。慢慢来。会在这里待一阵子，确保另一个医者没事。
All Roads to Peace#313.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#314.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#314.dst: 人类医者！你好！这是 Onluk 塔。Onluk 二号塔！人类帮过忙，所以欢迎人类。
All Roads to Peace#314.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#315.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#315.dst: 一号塔叫一号塔，因为 Onluk 先盖一号塔！这里不是 Onluk 平常待的地方。
All Roads to Peace#315.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#316.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#316.dst: 平常在小山丘上的塔，过桥那边。不过因为是自己盖的，塔摇摇晃晃。
All Roads to Peace#316.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#317.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#317.dst: 人类会帮忙。人类去拿结实的木头修塔？{p} 有结实的木头。森林也有木头，但魔法多过结实。
All Roads to Peace#317.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#319.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#319.dst: 啊哈！人类有柳木！Onluk 现在修塔！
All Roads to Peace#319.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#320.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#320.dst: 会修好 Onluk 一号塔！修好后来看！
All Roads to Peace#320.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#321.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: 一号塔修好了！呼啊哈！好耶！人类很会帮忙！
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: 该去看看！爬上塔，用十字弩射 Freelancer！
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#323.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: 看？Onluk 一号塔比 Onluk 二号塔好多了！上面很舒服，还看得到 Fruludir 的塔！
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#324.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: 人类很会帮忙。医者兼樵夫！修塔的——嗯，人类没修塔。修塔者的帮手！
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#325.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: 给，谢谢帮忙修 Onluk 一号塔！
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#326.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Ureietun 交谈，获准进入女酋长的小屋

All Roads to Peace#329.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: 人类想跟 Arrai-Veretel 谈。在小屋里。跟上。
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#330.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: Arrai-Veretel！人类在堡垒到处帮兽人。想谈。
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#331.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: 现在看人类了。不会再帮——要看 Arrai-Veretel 决定。
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#332.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#332.dst: 哼。Zuett 说过你。所以你就是想结束战争的人类？
All Roads to Peace#332.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#334.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: 你！你就是杀了 Rai-Poxper 的人类！你就是攻击别的堡垒的人类！
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#335.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: 要再跟 Zuett 谈。你跟上。而且你保持安静。明白？
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#336.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#336.dst: 跟着 Arrai-Veretel 进入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的议事厅

All Roads to Peace#337.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#337.dst: ZUETT！你说人类想要和平。你知道人类是谁吗？！
All Roads to Peace#337.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#338.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: 呃——这是好人类！治好 Ressinter——
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#341.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#341.dst: 人类也攻击别的堡垒！很多兽人因为这个人类死了！
All Roads to Peace#341.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#346.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#346.dst: 人类攻击！Rai-Poxper 因为停火被破坏而讨回应得的代价，但还不算战争。趁魔法力量失控时，从村民城市拿走魔法斧头。
All Roads to Peace#346.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#347.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#347.dst: 村民和人类先攻击，却因为兽人讨回应得代价而攻击兽人，好像兽人先攻击！而且人类杀了 Rai-Poxper！
All Roads to Peace#347.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#349.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#349.dst: 然后杀了 Rai-Poxper 的同一个人类来了，杀了洗澡的兽人，闯进堡垒，杀了很多 Centerworld 兽人！村民开始，兽人结束，村民不尊重结束！
All Roads to Peace#349.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#350.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#350.dst: 对，人类被村民骗了，但人类还是攻击兽人。人类还是杀了很多兽人！人类现在说想要和平？
All Roads to Peace#350.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#351.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#351.dst: 人类做了什么？猎野猪？帮医者？替别的兽人跑腿？那弥补不了失去的性命。
All Roads to Peace#351.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#352.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#352.dst: ……Arrai-Veretel 说得对。人类做的好事，弥补不了那些。但是，人类还在努力。如果一个人类试着停下，就会有更多人类试着停下。
All Roads to Peace#352.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#354.dst: 也许。也许会死更多兽人。Zuett，你没法说会发生什么。一厢情愿，我也希望那样会发生！
All Roads to Peace#354.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#355.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#355.dst: 但 Wynn 语没学完，兽人没法好好说话。你试试在笨蛋杀你的时候学语言！全都听起来很蠢，而且大部分人没时间学！
All Roads to Peace#355.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#356.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#356.dst: 但人类听 Zuett 说，就算听起来不聪明。Arrai-Veretel 不尊重人类。有道理，但还是会惹麻烦。
All Roads to Peace#356.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: 呃。好吧！Zuett 这么想要和平？人类这么想要和平？人类流了很多兽人的血。离开战争的唯一方法，就是打过去。我们来决斗。
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#358.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: 不耍花招。没有援兵。只有人类跟我之间的决斗。如果人类能在仪式竞技场打赢，就会听。
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#360.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: 还想用钢铁尸体机器威胁我们！所以，决斗会进行。会准备仪式、召集观众。准备好，人类。
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: 在兽人议事厅下方的竞技场击败 Arrai-Veretel。

All Roads to Peace#365.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: 愿大地之母倾听我们……尽管我们已不再如往昔那般言语……
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#366.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: 我们，作为她所赐予之土地上谦卑的居民，谨以此战向她致敬。
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#367.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: 愿她得以满足，愈发丰饶，并以此献礼回报我们的敬意。
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#370.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: 哼！人类很强硬。好——现在认真打！
All Roads to Peace#370.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#371.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: 为了那些死在我之前的人，我不会输！
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#374.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: 不，不！Arrai-Veretel 伤很重！人类想杀 Arrai-Veretel！！
All Roads to Peace#374.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#375.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: 我没事！蠢货，笨蛋！仪式决斗时不准打扰！
All Roads to Peace#375.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#376.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: 人类赢了。不想承认，但人类赢了。甚至没想杀我。
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#377.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: 给点时间。决斗打得很辛苦——需要缓一缓。在议事厅等。会……谈条件。
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: 停止一场不是我们开始的战争，感觉像是侮辱。但是，答应过了。人类很强。还是弥补不了那么多死亡……
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#379.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: 但人类在努力。真的，真的在努力。承认，看到时不知道人类杀了那么多……不过。如果战争结束，死亡也会结束。
All Roads to Peace#379.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#381.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: 会停止攻击城市。兽人还是会自卫！不会对着矛露出肚子。还是不信任村民——只给停火。
All Roads to Peace#381.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#383.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
All Roads to Peace#383.dst: 要说——平原上很多兽人记仇。很多兽人大概还会攻击。如果那样，人类也可以自卫。但人类应该避免在那里打。
All Roads to Peace#383.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#384.src: ...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
All Roads to Peace#384.dst: ……如果村民继续攻击，会跟以前一样自卫。人类，确保村民知道这点。
All Roads to Peace#384.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#385.src: Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
All Roads to Peace#385.dst: 嗯。村民比人类更蠢。村民做了很多可怕的事。但无尽的战争修复不了。
All Roads to Peace#385.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#387.src: So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: 所以 Zuett 不天真。有些事……不能……被……原谅。村民在边缘试探。
All Roads to Peace#387.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#388.src: Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
All Roads to Peace#388.dst: 人类见过北边腐烂的大地。一定见过，因为在腐烂的地方夺了堡垒。森林以前是活的。现在在死去。东北边已经死了。
All Roads to Peace#388.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#389.src: Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
All Roads to Peace#389.dst: 村民渡海离开前几十年才开始发生！村民总是逃避问题。
All Roads to Peace#389.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#390.src: And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: 而且村民自己制造问题。只可能是村民伤害大地，让她慢慢地、确实地死去。以前很多兽人住在那里。
All Roads to Peace#390.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#391.src: Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
All Roads to Peace#391.dst: 就算村民搬进来、想把兽人赶走，还是很多兽人住在那里……然后大地开始死去。还没蔓延到南边——而我们在南边！
All Roads to Peace#391.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#392.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: 但是……扯远了。不再打仗。把这个交给需要看的村民。
All Roads to Peace#392.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#393.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: 把停火协议交给 Goruca 上尉。

All Roads to Peace#394.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#394.dst: 人类！你回来了！还真是花了不少时间。考虑到种种情况，我想我不该意外。那些兽人很难缠。
All Roads to Peace#394.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#395.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: 这是什么？你真的让那帮野蛮人签了停火协议？！我还以为你会带着血淋淋的战利品回来，而不是一个签名！
All Roads to Peace#395.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: 不过，这是好事！条款比我希望的严密了点，但我想只要他们别来烦我们，怎样都行。
All Roads to Peace#397.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#398.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#398.dst: 嗯？兽人在说北边的衰败？不知道那有什么关系。又没人知道那是什么造成的。
All Roads to Peace#398.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#399.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: 我是说，你听说从 {p} 传出来的谣言了吗？说是女巫在诅咒这片土地，哈！嗯，那不是重点。
All Roads to Peace#399.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#400.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: 给——你的报酬。我本来打算给你这个面具，让你能扮成他们混进去，但我……嗯，我忘了，直到你已经出发了才想起来。
All Roads to Peace#400.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#401.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: 不过我确实用魔法把它强化成了一件厉害的装备！所以应该对你很有用。感谢你的效力，人类！
All Roads to Peace#401.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#402.src: ...A CATAPULT! Since when did orcs have the knowhow to make a CATAPULT?!
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: ……投石机！兽人是什么时候学会做投石机的？！
All Roads to Peace#402.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#403.src: Nonono, you don't understand- a CATAPULT?! Seriously, I can't get over this! Orc catapult! What's the world coming to?!
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: 不不不，你不懂——投石机？！说真的，我实在想不通！兽人投石机！这世界是怎么了？！
All Roads to Peace#403.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#404.src: Obviously it seems we need some backup, soldier. Would you mind coming along to the medical tent with me?
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: 显然，我们需要一些支援，士兵。你介意跟我去医疗帐篷一趟吗？
All Roads to Peace#404.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#405.src: ORC CATAPULT! I'm telling you, Captain! They crushed our guard golems with huge honking boulders! What are we supposed to do against that?!
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: 兽人投石机！我跟你说啊，上尉！他们用超大的石头把我们的魔像砸扁了！我们要怎么对付那种东西？！
All Roads to Peace#405.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#406.src: He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
All Roads to Peace#406.dst: 他说得对，上尉。魔像被砸烂之后，兽人就从堡垒里涌了出来。我们就四个人，要是不撤退，早就被杀了。
All Roads to Peace#406.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#407.src: Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: 人类！我跟你说说情况。自从你帮我们夺回北边的前哨站，兽人就变得凶狠多了。
All Roads to Peace#407.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#408.src: And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: 这就是你出场的时候了，士兵。我们需要你去兽人堡垒，突破他们的防线。也许，如果让他们看到我们的武力不输他们，他们就会听了，对吧？
All Roads to Peace#408.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#409.src: One against four... Human not beat even one. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: 一打四……人类连一个都打不赢。Ismikku！Hulve！
All Roads to Peace#409.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Mmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: 哼。起来。人类！起来！看到人类在喘气，你醒了！

All Roads to Peace#411.src: Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because kill orcs for "peace"?
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: 总之。你为什么来？为什么现在？给好理由。因为兽人为了“和平”杀人？
All Roads to Peace#411.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#412.src: [!] An Elite Boar has been spotted. The hunt begins!
All Roads to Peace#412.dst: [!] 发现了一头 Elite Boar。狩猎开始！

All Roads to Peace#413.src: [!] The Elite Boar can be identified by the particles above it's head.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: [!] Elite Boar 可以从头上的粒子效果认出来。

All Roads to Peace#414.src: [!] The boars will try to hide in the bushes around the hunting grounds.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: [!] 野猪会试着躲进猎场四周的灌木丛里。

All Roads to Peace#415.src: [!] Pay attention to what bush the Elite Boar is hiding in and give that bush a rustle with right-click to get the boars out of their hiding spots.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: [!] 注意 Elite Boar 躲在哪丛灌木里，用右键摇那丛灌木，把野猪赶出藏身处。

All Roads to Peace#416.src: ...hm. ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: ……嗯……………可以尊重人类的力量。能猎刺背，代表强。
All Roads to Peace#416.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#417.src: !! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
All Roads to Peace#417.dst: ！！Ressinter 是唯一的治疗师！Zuett 想当治疗师，Creinu 想当治疗师，但都不是！
All Roads to Peace#417.speaker: Guard Serepe

similar.text: {u}!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!

All Roads to Peace#418.src: Hm... HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
All Roads to Peace#418.dst: 唔……唔！！人类，呃，人类是好治疗师！自己受伤自己用药治好！人类会帮忙！
All Roads to Peace#418.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#419.src: The book depicts a tall, vine-like plant with red buds.
All Roads to Peace#419.dst: 书上画着一株高大的藤状植物，长着红色的花苞。

All Roads to Peace#420.src: There's a picture of fire on the skin...? Is it trying to say that sweetgale helps heal inflammation?
All Roads to Peace#420.dst: 有一张图画着皮肤上的火……？这是想说香杨梅能治发炎吗？

All Roads to Peace#421.src: Another diagram shows grubs on the body, and seems to show that applying the pulped buds kills the bugs? That's what the big red X over the grub implies...
All Roads to Peace#421.dst: 另一张图画着身上长虫，看起来是说把捣碎的花苞涂上去可以杀虫？虫身上那个大红叉大概是这个意思……

All Roads to Peace#422.src: The book depicts large groups of flowers in various colors, but primarily yellow.
All Roads to Peace#422.dst: 书上画着成群的花，颜色各异，但以黄色为主。

All Roads to Peace#423.src: Seems like yarrow can do a lot- there's a lot of disparate illustrations. One depicts a sneezing orc with two yarrow plants pointing at it, and the sneezing stopping.
All Roads to Peace#423.dst: 蓍草好像能做不少事——图画得很杂。其中一张画着一只打喷嚏的兽人，两株蓍草指着它，然后喷嚏就停了。

All Roads to Peace#424.src: A similar illustration shows an orc that appears to be having stomach cramps, if its hands being crossed over its stomach is any indication, with two yarrow plants pointed at it.
All Roads to Peace#424.dst: 另一张类似的图画着一只兽人，两只手交叠在肚子上，看起来是肚子绞痛，旁边有两株蓍草指着它。

All Roads to Peace#425.src: The third one shows an orc seemingly cut up, with red droplets coming off it. Again, two yarrow plants are pointed at it, and the next picture shows the cuts and droplets gone.
All Roads to Peace#425.dst: 第三张画着一只好像被割伤的兽人，身上滴着红色的水滴。同样有两株蓍草指着它，下一张图里伤口和水滴都不见了。

All Roads to Peace#426.src: The book depicts small, dainty flowers with white petals.
All Roads to Peace#426.dst: 书上画着小巧精致、花瓣雪白的花。

All Roads to Peace#427.src: There's a detailed picture of the plant, with arrows pointing to multiple different illustrated orcs each showing different things.
All Roads to Peace#427.dst: 有一张植物的细部图，箭头指向好几只画出来的兽人，每一只表现的状况都不一样。

All Roads to Peace#428.src: One orc is shown to be agitated, and then subsequently sleeping. Another is...shown with red patches on the skin, and fire next to it, which is replaced with water droplets in the next drawing. The red patches are gone.
All Roads to Peace#428.dst: 一只兽人画得焦躁不安，接着就睡着了。另一只……皮肤上有红斑，旁边画着火，下一张图里火换成了水滴。红斑不见了。

All Roads to Peace#429.src: The last one shows various cuts and gashes on a third orc that's emitting red droplets, and then smaller cuts without any red drops on the next depiction...
All Roads to Peace#429.dst: 最后一张画着第三只兽人身上大小不一的伤口，渗出红色的水滴，接着下一张图里伤口变小，也没有红点了……

All Roads to Peace#430.src: ...but the next page is showing an orc with X's over its eyes, and arrows from multiple chamomile plants pointing to it. Does that mean too much chamomile is bad?
All Roads to Peace#430.dst: ……但下一页画的是一只眼睛被打上叉的兽人，好几株洋甘菊用箭头指着它。这是说洋甘菊用太多不好吗？

All Roads to Peace#431.src: The book depicts a shrub-like plant with white petals and buds.
All Roads to Peace#431.dst: 书上画着一株灌木状的植物，有白色的花瓣和花苞。

All Roads to Peace#432.src: It looks like this is good for healing a lot of things. The pictures show a sweating, feverish orc, one clutching its stomach, a female one clutching her stomach, and what can be assumed to be an orc with...a toothache?
All Roads to Peace#432.dst: 看起来这个能治不少毛病。图上画着一只冒汗发烧的兽人、一只按着肚子的、一只按着肚子的雌兽人，还有一只大概是……牙痛的兽人？

All Roads to Peace#433.src: Seems to imply that feverfew is good for dealing with all of those kinds of maladies.
All Roads to Peace#433.dst: 看起来是在说小白菊对那些毛病都有用。

All Roads to Peace#434.src: The bleeding seems to have slowed down a little bit, but the medicine orc is still badly injured. The balm must not have been effective. You'll have to make another one.
All Roads to Peace#434.dst: 流血好像稍微慢了一点，但那只医药兽人还是伤得很重。药膏一定没有奏效。你得再做一份。

All Roads to Peace#435.src: Not know much about medicine yet. Medicine give to you, last one- Was made before. Know this though.
All Roads to Peace#435.dst: 对药还不太懂。给你的药，是最后一份——以前做的。不过这个知道。

All Roads to Peace#436.src: Ressinter bleeding bad. Find herb good for bleeding. Won't need more than two herb of type, too.
All Roads to Peace#436.dst: Ressinter 流血流得很严重。找对止血好的草药。同一种草药也不会需要超过两株。

All Roads to Peace#437.src: The book depicts broad, yellow-green leaves.
All Roads to Peace#437.dst: 书上画着宽大的黄绿色叶子。

All Roads to Peace#438.src: There's an image of an orc with red droplets coming off it, and an arrow with a picture of a gingko leaf pointing at it- the arrow is crossed out. That could mean multiple things.
All Roads to Peace#438.dst: 有一张图画着一只身上滴着红点的兽人，一个带着银杏叶图案的箭头指着它——那个箭头被划掉了。那可能有好几种意思。

All Roads to Peace#439.src: The next page shows a gingko leaf pointed at an illustration of a brain, and a similar arrow points from a frowning orc to a smiling one.
All Roads to Peace#439.dst: 下一页画着一片银杏叶指向一颗脑的图，另一个类似的箭头从一只皱眉的兽人指向一只在笑的兽人。

All Roads to Peace#440.src: So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
All Roads to Peace#440.dst: 所以这是说它对情绪和心神有好处……而且跟流血有关，但你看不出来是好还是坏。

All Roads to Peace#441.src: The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
All Roads to Peace#441.dst: 书上画着橙红色的花穗，几乎像香蒲一样。

All Roads to Peace#442.src: There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
All Roads to Peace#442.dst: 有一张大图画着一只全身布满大片紫色斑块的兽人，旁边还有一张类似的图，斑块换成了橘色。

All Roads to Peace#443.src: That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
All Roads to Peace#443.dst: 这是说把磨碎的鹿蹄草涂在那里……画的大概是淤青。

All Roads to Peace#444.src: Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
All Roads to Peace#444.dst: 类似的橘色斑点被涂在一道明显的伤口上，隔一张图里同一道伤口就变小了。

All Roads to Peace#445.src: Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
All Roads to Peace#445.dst: 接着有几张图画的好像是……血管？旁边写了一大堆兽人文字，所以那些到底是什么意思你完全看不出来。

All Roads to Peace#446.src: The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
All Roads to Peace#446.dst: 书上画着一株矮灌木，细茎上长满鲜红的浆果。

All Roads to Peace#447.src: There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
All Roads to Peace#447.dst: 有好几张图画的好像是生病的兽人——图上画着打喷嚏和咳嗽。

All Roads to Peace#448.src: One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
All Roads to Peace#448.dst: 有一张图画着一只看起来痛得厉害的兽人，箭头从接骨木莓指向那些图形。

All Roads to Peace#449.src: Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
All Roads to Peace#449.dst: 你最好的猜测是接骨木莓能治轻微的病，也许还能减轻疼痛。

All Roads to Peace#450.src: The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
All Roads to Peace#450.dst: 这次药膏好像也没用。他还在大量流血。也许你可以直接……把伤口全盖起来，然后祈祷？又或者那不是个好主意。

All Roads to Peace#451.src: Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
All Roads to Peace#451.dst: 还是没有明显效果。那只兽人的呼吸越来越浅……

All Roads to Peace#452.src: ... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
All Roads to Peace#452.dst: 同意。不过我们该回去做自己的事了。
All Roads to Peace#452.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#453.src: If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
All Roads to Peace#453.dst: 如果她担心你只是在听命令，那你自己主动去帮帮兽人，Ureietun 或许会改变想法。

All Roads to Peace#454.src: There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
All Roads to Peace#454.dst: 附近有很多兽人。去问他们需不需要帮忙应该不难。

All Roads to Peace#455.src: Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#455.dst: 人类笨吗？我说了不能见 Arrai-Veretel！

All Roads to Peace#456.src: Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
All Roads to Peace#456.dst: 那就这样了——Fruludir 拿到他的包裹了。该回去找 Peloros 了。
